learning_outcomes.text: The student has structured knowledge of the basic methods and applications of artificial intelligence, including machine learning, image analysis, and data-driven diagnostics relevant to mechanical engineering.
The student is able to select and apply appropriate artificial intelligence methods and tools to solve practical engineering problems related to machine diagnostics and predictive maintenance.

The student is able to plan and carry out AI-based experiments (e.g., training, testing, validation of models), interpret results and draw conclusions regarding their applicability to mechanical systems.
The student is able to work effectively as a member of an engineering team, demonstrates responsibility and communication skills in collaborative development of AI-based solutions.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental concepts, historical development, and classification of Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods
Application of AI in mechanical engineering
Supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, including training, testing, and validation procedures
Sensor data analysis from machines and industrial systems
Use of AI in predictive maintenance, based on historical and real-time operational data
Limitations of AI algorithms, their reliability, interpretability, and ethical considerations in engineering applications
Installation and configuration of programming environments
Acquaintance with Python and machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Implementation and training of basic machine learning models for classification and regression problems in mechanical systems
Construction and training of neural networks to analyze signals (vibration, temperature, operational data)
Application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to technical image analysis (surface defect detection, component wear identification)
Sensor data analysis to predict mechanical failures
Practical project: design and implementation of an AI-based diagnostic or predictive system for a selected mechanical component or subsystem

assessment_methods.method: Completion of all assigned programming tasks and reports

assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all required learning outcomes, including positive grades from laboratory reports, project implementation, and the final examination. Active participation in laboratory classes and completion of all assigned programming tasks and reports are mandatory. A minimum threshold of 50% of the total available points is required to pass the course. Students must demonstrate the ability to apply theoretical knowledge and AI techniques to solve practical engineering problems.
